verdict: Yes. Auli from Kolkata pitched ayurvedic skincare and lifestyle products on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Ayurvedic skincare is trusted by Indian buyers and popular abroad, but you need an AYUSH licence and honest claims.
angle: Ayurvedic oils, serums and face packs based on traditional recipes sell to buyers who prefer natural products. Premium packaging and sourcing stories command high prices. The AYUSH licence and quality testing are essential.
